title: Rafael and the Will
author: Isandro Voss
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
